findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：2022 年 Petrobras／Unaoil 的 DOJ、SEC 與巴西當局調查已和解；2025 年 7 月 DOJ 聲請提前終止 DPA，法院准許，相關指控已不得再訴而撤銷。
findings.excerpt: In July 2025, the DOJ filed, and the court granted, a motion for early termination of the DPA, and the deferred charges related to the UOP Matters have been dismissed with prejudice.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 風險因素列出反壟斷等訴訟與調查屬一般性風險，未指明現行具體反壟斷調查。
findings.excerpt: We are currently, and may in the future become, subject to lawsuits, fines, investigations, and disputes (some of which involve substantial amounts claimed) arising out of the conduct of our business

regulatory_antitrust.note: 三次搜尋未找到 2026 年針對 HON 的 DOJ／FTC／EU 反壟斷調查；只見舊案（EU 1234yf 冷媒案等，日期不明）。Johnson Matthey 催化劑部門收購尚有監管核准待辦（搜尋摘要，未讀原文）。
